item.title: 基于 K8S 的 RuoYi 微服务容器化部署
item.description:

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name _;
    location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
        index index.html index.htm;
    }
    location /prod-api/ {
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header REMOTE-HOST $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_pass http://ruoyi-gateway:8080/;
    }
    location /ruoyi-bucket {
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header REMOTE-HOST $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_pass http://minio:9000;
    }
}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: redis }
spec:
  ports: [{ port: 6379 }]
  selector: { app: redis }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: redis }
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: redis } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: redis } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ddn-k8s/docker.io/redis:7.2-alpine
          command: ["redis-server", "--requirepass", "Chen123456!", "--appendonly", "yes"]

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: mysql }
spec:
  ports: [{ port: 3306 }]
  selector: { app: mysql }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: mysql }
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: mysql } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: mysql } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: mysql
          image: crpi-ygijwidbw2jwxum2.cn-hangzhou.personal.cr.aliyuncs.com/erha_test1/ruoyi-mysql:v1
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              value: "Chen123456!"
            - name: MYSQL_DATABASE      
              value: "ruoyi"
            - name: TZ
              value: "Asia/Shanghai"
          volumeMounts: [{ name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/mysql }]
      volumes:
        - name: data
          hostPath: { path: /data/k8s-volumes/mysql-data, type: DirectoryOrCreate }

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: minio }
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - name: api
      port: 9000
      targetPort: 9000
    - name: console
      port: 9001
      targetPort: 9001
      nodePort: 30091
  selector: { app: minio }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: minio }
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: minio } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: minio } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: minio
          image: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ddn-k8s/docker.io/minio/minio:latest
          command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
          env:
            - name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
              value: "admin"
            - name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
              value: "Chen123456!"
          volumeMounts: [{ name: data, mountPath: /data }]
      volumes:
        - name: data
          hostPath: { path: /data/k8s-volumes/minio-data, type: DirectoryOrCreate }

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: nacos }
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - { port: 8848, targetPort: 8848, nodePort: 30848 }
    - { port: 9848, targetPort: 9848 }
  selector: { app: nacos }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: nacos }
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: nacos } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: nacos } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nacos
          image: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ddn-k8s/docker.io/nacos/nacos-server:v2.5.2
          env:
            - { name: MODE, value: "standalone" }
            - { name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_PLATFORM, value: "mysql" }
            - { name: MYSQL_SERVICE_HOST, value: "mysql" }
            - { name: MYSQL_SERVICE_PORT, value: "3306" }
            - { name: MYSQL_SERVICE_DB_NAME, value: "ruoyi" }
            - { name: MYSQL_SERVICE_USER, value: "root" }
            - { name: MYSQL_SERVICE_PASSWORD, value: "Chen123456!" }
            - { name: JVM_XMS, value: "256m" }
            - { name: JVM_XMX, value: "256m" }

kubectl apply -f 1-middleware.yaml

apiVersion: v1

spec:
  ports: [{ port: 8080, targetPort: 8080 }]
  selector: { app: ruoyi-gateway }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: sentinel }
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports: [{ port: 8718, targetPort: 8718, nodePort: 30718 }]
  selector: { app: sentinel-dashboard-1.8.9 }
EOF

# 写入微服务
SERVICES=("sentinel-dashboard-1.8.9" "ruoyi-gateway" "ruoyi-auth" "ruoyi-modules-system" "ruoyi-modules-file" "ruoyi-modules-job" "ruoyi-modules-gen")

for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
cat >> 2-business.yaml << YAML_EOF
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: $svc
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: $svc
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: $svc
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: $svc
          image: crpi-ygijwidbw2jwxum2.cn-hangzhou.personal.cr.aliyuncs.com/erha_test1/$svc:v1
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: ruoyi-nginx }
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 80, nodePort: 30088 }]
  selector: { app: ruoyi-nginx }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: ruoyi-nginx }
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: ruoyi-nginx } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: ruoyi-nginx } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: crpi-ygijwidbw2jwxum2.cn-hangzhou.personal.cr.aliyuncs.com/erha_test1/ruoyi-nginx:v1

kubectl apply -f 2-business.yaml
